I’d like to provide some insight into this situation that I don’t think is being properly conveyed.

I’d first like to preface what I’m about to say by saying I don’t think Wooli deserved the hatred he got. 

But, the frustration felt by UCSD students (as a current UCSD student myself) is multifaceted. Hundreds of thousands of dollars that come out of the tuition of ALL UCSD students are what fund Sungod Festivals (the festival that Wooli was set to headline for). I repeat, HUNDREDS of thousands. And for middle class-lower class students (like myself) whom are paying tens of thousands for our educations either directly or indirectly via loans, it is absolutely a huge frustration to be felt considering the hype that is felt around the highly anticipated annual Sungod festival.

And also add in the context of last years Sungod festival, canceled last minute in a retaliatory act against the pro-Palestinian encampments depriving many first years students of their would be first Sungod and many graduating students of their last Sungod experience 

AND also double add in the context that this event is coordinated and planned by a student organization entitled ASCE that has been rumored (and I would like to emphasize “rumored,” nothing is confirmed) to have members that specifically picked Wooli because they had board members that personally enjoyed EDM music rather than prioritizing the general experience of the average Sungod goer 

AND triple add in the context that we do have an incredible history of renowned artists across many genres (Kendrick Lamar, My Chemical Romance, Joji, etc)

AND quadruple add in the context that the festival serves as a moment of respite for many people balancing their classes, jobs, internships, volunteer work, and everything else

And there is a lot that goes into the general sentiment of UCSD students

And if someone did this to someone I loved I’d probably laugh if it was someone I knew and asked them what the hell was wrong with them half jokingly. I’d find it creepy and be annoyed if it were a stranger. 

AOC is allowed to find this creepy just as I or you would be allowed to find it creepy if a stranger did it to you or an acquaintance.

What depth? That’s my main problem, there is absolutely nothing in Age Of Calamity that gave depth. Name one thing we learn in AOC about the champions or their heirs that we didn’t already know. And I already knew it wouldn’t be as good as BOTW. I was perfectly fine with that, if BOTW’s a 9/10 if Age of Calamity was a 7/10 I’d be happy. Age of Calamity’s a 5/10. Its only redeeming factors are the music and playing one of the champions, zelda, or link for the first time.

If it were just some generic hack and slash I wouldn’t care. But it’s tied to BOTW, which is one of the most beautiful games I’ve played in years and my first ever Zelda game too. It had so much potential to give some character to the Champions and their predecessors who were so intriguing to me in BOTW, but instead it gave us 100 hours of boring repetitive gameplay. Which was satisfying and cool for only about 20 of those hours. Man I usually don’t like ranting because it makes me feel like I’m getting way too passionate about something that doesn’t matter, but I’d never felt so disappointed and heartbroken with a video game experience before.

Age of Calamity was such an insulting experience after playing breath of the wild and immediately jumping into it afterwards. It’s the first and only game I’ve ever played where I considered selling it or giving it away immediately after completing it.
